build: Modwerk's linker: the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…3e58) + rytm2_mods v1.2 filter-hz (25055fc7…512a), --version FZ74
conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; FLTR opens the FILTER page of track BD; encoder 4 (FRQ) is turned down from 127 to 60 and back to 127. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. In rytm-emu c5732f0 on FZ74 this plan gives these three frames byte for byte; across its 104 screens it differs from stock 1.74 only in the FRQ label (x 3-96, y 144-158), except turns 60, 70 and 80, mid-turn frames where the two runs had reached different FRQ values. The files were first captured (2026-10-14) with rytm-emu 3c4c42c on FZ01, an OS 1.73 build, which gives the same three frames. Filter Hz 1.2.0's package links to FZ74's main OS (evidence/source-parity.json).
